newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: POLL-Bank of Portugal rates seen staying unchanged.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Bank of Portugal rates seen staying unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal will probably leave its key money market rates unchanged on Friday when it announces conditions for the next commercial bank reserve period, according to a Reuters poll of eight analysts.

The analysts were unanimous in seeing no change after the Bank cut 30 basis points off rates last Friday. Its repurchase pact rate stands at 5.7 percent, while the drain, or absorption rate stands at 5.4 percent.

The following banks and brokerages took part in the poll and agreed to be identified: Banco Portugues de Investimento, IMF-Informacao de Mercados Financeiros, Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais, Credit Lyonnais, Banco de Comercio e Industria, Banco Mello de Investimentos.
